meta.engagement_formula: per-post ER% = (visible likes + visible comments) / IG follower count from og:description * 100; account ER = median per-post ER over posts authored by the account itself with visible likes. og follower counts are rounded (e.g. 99K), so ER is approximate.
meta.classification_note: Flags (dubai, testimonial, placement_job, fees_cost, parent, visa, event_fair) are keyword matches on English caption text (Arabic/Malayalam captions not matched) - indicative, not manual coding. For Dubai-campus accounts the dubai flag is near-universal by design.
meta.fb_reels_tile_note: The unlabeled number on each FB reels-tab tile does not match the labeled view counts on the reel page; its meaning is unconfirmed and it is NOT used in any calculation.
meta.not_available: Reach, impressions, saves, shares (except where FB visibly shows a share count), Insights - never accessed.
